info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Banyan Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API allows users to create detailed entries for Banyan Notebooks in the catalog. It facilitates the submission of all relevant properties associated with the notebooks, ensuring organized management of catalog information. Typical consumers of this API include inventory managers and product developers seeking to update product offerings. By using this endpoint, businesses can streamline the process of adding new notebook details while maintaining an accurate catalog.

post.summary: Create a new Banyan notebook detail.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new details for a Banyan notebook, enabling the organization and management of notebook content effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details related to the banyan notebook operations. It must include all required fields as defined in the schema, ensuring that the necessary information is provided for successful processing.

200.description: Request completed successfully and details retrieved.

CreateCatalogBanyanNotebookDetailRequest.title: Banyan Notebook Request Body

banyan_notebook_id.description: The unique identifier for the banyan notebook.

requestedBy.description: The name or identifier of the person requesting the operation.

quantity.description: The quantity of banyan notebooks requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates if the request is of high priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the banyan notebook.

CreateCatalogBanyanNotebookDetailRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for creating or updating details of a banyan notebook operation.

CreateCatalogBanyanNotebookDetailRespons.title: Notebook Operation Response

status.description: The status of the operation, indicating success or failure.

recordId.description: The unique identifier for the created or modified record.

processedAt.description: The date and time when the operation was processed, in ISO 8601 format.

matchedCount.description: The number of records that matched the operation criteria.

CreateCatalogBanyanNotebookDetailRespons.description: Response schema for a successful notebook operation. This schema includes details about the operation's status, the ID of the record created or modified, the timestamp of when it was processed, and the count of matched records.
